title: Obsidian: Residency-aware scheduled reporting and audit export orchestration
creator: Asha Menon
description: Build an orchestration layer and UX for region-aware and tenant-scoped scheduled reporting that can produce signed PDF/CSV audit bundles, persist evidence to region-specific storage, and deliver via configurable transports (S3, SFTP, email). The goal is to provide an auditable export pipeline that respects data residency and retention guardrails, supports end-to-end encryption at rest/in transit, and surfaces delivery status in the Console dashboard. This ticket covers the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and coordinating tasks with Eng and Design for the first-phase MVP (report templates + scheduler + delivery connector + dashboard indicators).
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create scheduled reports scoped to a tenant and a residency region
Report payloads can be emitted in both PDF and CSV formats using templated layouts
Exports are stored in tenant-owned buckets or region-scoped storage with server-side encryption and KMS key selection
Delivery connector supports S3 (signed URL), SFTP, and secure email; failures are retried with exponential backoff
Retention window applied to exported artifacts and automatic purge job logs the action for audit
Console shows per-report status, last-run timestamp, size, and a link to evidence; team can filter by region and retention state
Audit trail includes creator, schedule definition, successful deliveries, failures, and operator overrides
Security review completed and design passes privacy review for cross-region metadata exposure
notes: 2026-02-18: Initial scoping session with Eng (Liam), Security (Priya), and Design (Marco). Decided to scope MVP to three delivery targets: S3, SFTP, email. Asked Eng to prototype signed S3 URLs vs temporary credentials.

2026-02-24: Design mockups uploaded to Confluence. Chose compact table + timeline visual for Console. Action: Design to produce print-ready PDF template that accommodates variable-length evidence rows.
2026-03-02: Eng spike results - streaming CSV generation reduces peak memory usage vs batch assembly. ENG-5022 will implement streaming CSV APIs; estimate +3 pts if we include on-the-fly compression.

2026-03-06: Security flagged metadata leakage risk when listing exported artifacts across regions. Decision: restrict artifact listing to tenant-scoped IAM roles; Console will surface only permitted metadata.
2026-03-10: Legal requested retention retention-defaults per region. Product to provide region defaults and allow org override with guardrails. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-12: PRD updated with retry/backoff policy for delivery connectors and failure webhook contract for customer notification. Link to PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COM/Obsidian+Reporting+PRD
2026-03-13: Engineering review notes: need an events table for export runs (ENG-6420). Also add metric hooks for export latency and failure rate to infra dashboards.
2026-03-14: Begin coordination for QA test plan: include cross-region end-to-end test cases, KMS key rotation, and retention purge verification. QA owner: @Janelle

Design PDF templates that support long tables and per-tenant branding (design)

Build S3/SFTP/email connectors with retry logic and KMS selection (ENG-6420)
